name: Orbit
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="3">
    <description>
      An RD that uses an iteration step implemented to treat reagents a and b as a complex number (a+bi) and raising it to a power, similarly to a Nova orbits-fractal step.
Implemented by Dan Wills.
</a>
    </description>
    <rule name="Orbit" type="formula" wrap="1" neighborhood_type="vertex" neighborhood_range="1" neighborhood_weight="laplacian">
      <param name="timestep">
        0.05
      </param>
      <param name="clampMin">
        -15
      </param>
      <param name="clampMax">
        15
      </param>
      <param name="relaxReal">
        0.3
      </param>
      <param name="relaxImag">
        0.2
      </param>
      <param name="constReal">
        -0.3
      </param>
      <param name="constImag">
        0.1
      </param>
      <param name="realPower">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="imagPower">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="D_a">
        0.5
      </param>
      <param name="D_b">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="mag_amp">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="mag_power">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="mag_add">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="phase_offset">
        -1
      </param>
      <param name="phase_scale">
        1
      </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="4">
        // where:
// z is the complex value (a+bi).
// p is the complex power (c+di).
// R is the complex relaxation (e+if).
// c is the complex offset (g+ih).
// E is the constant e (a literal is used here: 2.718281828459045235360287471352)


// complex power of (a+ib), where MAG is its magnitude and PHASE is its phase:
// real part: pow( MAG, realPower) * pow( E, -imagPower * PHASE ) * cos( realPower * PHASE + imagPower * log( MAG ) )
// imag part: same as real but with sin instead of cos


// Nova is: z -> z - R * ( (z^p - 1) / (p * z^(p-1)) ) + complexOffset
// numerator: (z^p - 1)
// denominator: (p * z^(p-1))
// denominator: ( c + di ) * ( a + bi )^( ( c + di ) - 1)
// denominator, power part, real:
//     pow( c, (realPower-1) ) * pow( E, -imagPower*d ) * cos( imagPower * log( c ) + (realPower-1) * d )


c = pow(a*a + b*b, mag_power) * mag_amp + mag_add;
d = atan2( b, a ) * phase_scale + phase_offset;


float4 p = pow( c, realPower) * pow( 2.718281828459045235360287471352, -imagPower*d ) * cos( imagPower * log( c ) + realPower * d );
float4 q = pow( c, realPower) * pow( 2.718281828459045235360287471352, -imagPower*d ) * sin( imagPower * log( c ) + realPower * d );
float4 r = pow( c, realPower-1.0) * pow( 2.718281828459045235360287471352, -imagPower*d ) * cos( imagPower * log( c ) + (realPower-1.0) * d );
float4 s = pow( c, realPower-1.0) * pow( 2.718281828459045235360287471352, -imagPower*d ) * sin( imagPower * log( c ) + (realPower-1.0) * d );


float4 e = relaxReal;
float4 f = relaxImag;
float4 g = constReal;
float4 h = constImag;
float4 t = realPower;
float4 u = imagPower;


// hopefully formula crunching on paper didn't go awry!
// a is a and b is b, norce.. as in, the components of z
// c and d are without a (coz of the magphase reagents) they were the complex power components on paper, so lets remap c => t and d => u
// so, from paper, eek!
//REAL delta: -epcr + epds - ecr + eds + fqcr - fqds - eqcs - eqdr - fpcs 0 fpdr + fcs + fdr + g
//IMAG delta: csep + drep + ecs + edr - fqcs - fqdr -eqcr + eqds - fpcr + fpds + fcr - fds + h
// now with translation
delta_a = clamp( timestep * ( -e*p*t*r + e*p*u*s - e*t*r + e*u*s + f*q*t*r - f*q*u*s - e*q*t*s - e*q*u*r - f*p*t*s - f*p*u*r + f*t*s + f*u*r + g + D_a * laplacian_a), clampMin, clampMax );
delta_b = clamp( timestep * ( t*s*e*p + u*r*e*p + e*t*s + e*u*r - f*q*t*s - f*q*u*r -e*q*t*r + e*q*u*s - f*p*t*r + f*p*u*s + f*t*r - f*u*s + h + D_b * laplacian_b), clampMin, clampMax );


//delta_a = clamp( timestep * pow( c, realPower) * pow( 2.718281828459045235360287471352, -imagPower*d ) * cos( imagPower * log( c ) + realPower * d ) + D_a * laplacian_a + constReal, clampMin, clampMax );
//delta_b = clamp( timestep * pow( c, realPower) * pow( 2.718281828459045235360287471352, -imagPower*d ) * sin( imagPower * log( c ) + realPower * d ) + D_b * laplacian_b + constImag, clampMin, clampMax );
      </formula>
      
    </rule>
    <initial_pattern_generator apply_when_loading="false">

        <overwrite>
          
        </overwrite>

      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="b">

        </overwrite>

          </point3D>
          
        </rectangle>
        
      </overlay>
      
    </initial_pattern_generator>
